name: MIR (NSPK payment system)
note: МИР chest patch on HC CSKA Moscow's 2026-27 jerseys (club photo galleries, September 2026); NSPK also appears as an official partner in the KHL partners block syndicated on club sites. NSPK, the operator of the Mir payment system, is 100% owned by the Central Bank of the Russian Federation. RBC reported in July 2026 that the CBR may sell a stake from 2027.
